name: cavemio-request-lifecycle-preview
title: Request Lifecycle Preview
author: Cavemio
description: A persistent request card with Asked, Planned, Shipped and Answered scenes.

cavemio.accessibility: Inactive scenes are inert and hidden from assistive technology. Reduced motion disables movement, fades and vote counting. Layout measures wrapping content to avoid clipping.
cavemio.previewNote: Four lifecycle scenes with local demo content. Supply your own data and connect the selected stage to your application.

props.name: stage
props.description: Required. Current stage of the request lifecycle.

props.name: data
props.description: Required. Request title and description, votes, voters, activity, roadmap, release, and email content.

props.name: labels
props.type: { pending?: string; planned?: string; completed?: string; votes?: string; emailed?: string; voters?: string; justNow?: string; }
props.description: Optional. Translations for lifecycle status and supporting labels.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional. Additional CSS classes for the root element.

props.name: style
props.description: Optional. Inline styles for the root element.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Optional. Accessible name for the component.
